title: "Modelling CFB Coaches"

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(11125)
```

Read in the data including values to which we want to predict

```{r}
coach_all_df<-read.csv("data/cfb_coaches_all.csv") %>%
  filter(first_season<2025)
coach_pred_df<-read.csv("data/cfb_coaches_all.csv") %>%
  filter(first_season==2026)

```

Do so replacing of NA's when we do not have data on a coach with zero's. This is effectively creating an interaction with whether or not we have data but it is somewhat problematic for the following variables since the \_rel ones have zero as a reasonable value.

```{r}
coach_all_df$prevCollegeHC=as.numeric(is.na(coach_all_df$sp_prev_rel))
coach_all_df$sp_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_all_df$sp_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_all_df$srs_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_all_df$srs_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_all_df$winpct_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_all_df$winpct_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_all_df$AllPriorWinPct=replace_na(coach_all_df$AllPriorWinPct,replace=0)
coach_all_df$numb_seasons=coach_all_df$last_season-coach_all_df$first_season+1
```

Specify our target variable, *y*, and our matrix of predictors, *X*.

```{r}
y=coach_all_df$sp_rel_team

X=coach_all_df %>%
  mutate(numb_years_Coord_HCadj=numb_years_Coord_HC-mean(numb_years_Coord_HC))%>%
  mutate(numb_years_Coord_HCadj2=numb_years_Coord_HCadj^2)%>%
  mutate(Side_O=as.numeric(SideOfBall=="O"))%>%
  select(prevCollegeHC,ConnectionToHiring.School,NFLCoachingExperience,
         RecruitingCoord,PlayedNFL,Played.Power.4,WonNCasHCany,
         WonCCasHCany,WonNCasCoordAny,WonCCasCoordAny,LeavingNFL,Regional.Ties,
         numb_years_Coord_HCadj,numb_years_Coord_HCadj2, AllPriorWinPct,
         PreviousHC,PreviousOC,PreviousDC, Conf.LeavingP4,SameConf,AgeAtHiringMinus50,
         sp_prev_rel,winpct_prev_rel,team_sp_prev,team_sp_recent,
         GamesAsHCPrior, team_winpct_recent,Side_O,PromoteWithin,NumberPriorStops) %>%
  as.matrix()

```

Make X_pred matrix for prediction of new obs

```{r}

coach_pred_df$prevCollegeHC=as.numeric(is.na(coach_pred_df$sp_prev_rel))
coach_pred_df$sp_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_pred_df$sp_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_pred_df$srs_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_pred_df$srs_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_pred_df$winpct_prev_rel=replace_na(coach_pred_df$winpct_prev_rel,replace=0)
coach_pred_df$AllPriorWinPct=replace_na(coach_pred_df$AllPriorWinPct,replace=0)

X_pred = coach_pred_df %>%
  mutate(numb_years_Coord_HCadj=numb_years_Coord_HC-mean(numb_years_Coord_HC))%>%
  mutate(numb_years_Coord_HCadj2=numb_years_Coord_HCadj^2)%>%
  mutate(Side_O=as.numeric(SideOfBall=="O"))%>%
  select(prevCollegeHC,ConnectionToHiring.School,NFLCoachingExperience,
         RecruitingCoord,PlayedNFL,Played.Power.4,WonNCasHCany,
         WonCCasHCany,WonNCasCoordAny,WonCCasCoordAny,LeavingNFL,Regional.Ties,
         numb_years_Coord_HCadj,numb_years_Coord_HCadj2, AllPriorWinPct,
         PreviousHC,PreviousOC,PreviousDC, Conf.LeavingP4,SameConf,AgeAtHiringMinus50,
         sp_prev_rel,winpct_prev_rel,team_sp_prev,team_sp_recent,
         GamesAsHCPrior, team_winpct_recent,Side_O,PromoteWithin, NumberPriorStops) %>%
  as.matrix()
```

## Lasso

Run Lasso with cross-validation

```{r}

cv_cfb_lasso<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=1,nfolds=8, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))

coef(cv_cfb_lasso, s = "lambda.1se")
coef(cv_cfb_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
plot(cv_cfb_lasso)


```

## Ridge

Run Ridge with cross-validation

```{r}

cv_cfb_ridge<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=0,nfolds=8, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))

coef(cv_cfb_ridge, s = "lambda.1se")
coef(cv_cfb_ridge, s = "lambda.min")
plot(cv_cfb_ridge)


```

```{r}
fit_lasso<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_lasso$lambda.min,alpha=1, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
fit_lasso$beta

print(coef(fit_lasso, s = "lambda.min")[1,1])
betas_lasso=coef(fit_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
```

Look at lasso with full within sample data

```{r}
fit_lasso<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_lasso$lambda.min,alpha=1,, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
pred_lasso_min=predict(fit_lasso,X,type="response")
sum((pred_lasso_min-y)^2)

fit_lasso<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_ridge$lambda.1se,alpha=1,, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
pred_lasso_1se=predict(fit_lasso,X,type="response")
sum((pred_lasso_1se-y)^2)

```

Run Ridge with Cross-Validation

```{r}
cv_cfb_ridge<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=0,nfolds=8)

coef(cv_cfb_ridge, s = "lambda.1se")
coef(cv_cfb_ridge, s = "lambda.min")
plot(cv_cfb_ridge)
```

```{r}
fit_ridge<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_ridge$lambda.1se,alpha=0,, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
fit_ridge$beta
# get coefficienes for ridge regression with lambda.min 
# lambda.min is the value of lambda that generated the lowest
# cross validated error
betas_ridge=coef(fit_ridge, s = "lambda.min")
```

Look at ridge with full in sample data

```{r}
fit_ridge<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_lasso$lambda.min,alpha=0, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
pred_ridge_min=predict(fit_ridge,X,type="response")
sum((pred_ridge_min-y)^2)

fit_ridge<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=cv_cfb_ridge$lambda.1se,alpha=0, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
pred_ridge_1se=predict(fit_ridge,X,type="response")
sum((pred_ridge_1se-y)^2)

# get intercept term for ridge regression at lambda with lowest 
print(coef(fit_ridge, s = "lambda.min")[1,1])
```

Comparing results for Lasso and Ridge on Cross validation

```{r}
min(cv_cfb_lasso$cvm)
min(cv_cfb_ridge$cvm)
```

## Cross-validation

So far, lasso does better with cross validation and ridge does better on purely in sample. We are going to go with the one that is superior on the cross-validation but let's do more than one randomization of the cross-validation. So below we do 20 randomizations of the 'folds'.

Run a loop across different folds to get cvm from lasso and ridge as well as get value for lambda.min.

```{r}

numb_reps=20
out=data.frame(lasso_cvm=rep(NA,numb_reps),
               ridge_cvm=rep(NA,numb_reps),
               lasso_lambda_min=rep(NA,numb_reps),
               ridge_lambda_min=rep(NA,numb_reps))



set.seed(111525)
for (i in 1: numb_reps)
{
cv_cfb_ridge<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=0,nfolds=8, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
cv_cfb_lasso<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=1,nfolds=8, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
out$lasso_cvm[i]=min(cv_cfb_lasso$cvm)
out$lasso_lambda_min=cv_cfb_lasso$lambda.min
out$ridge_cvm[i]=min(cv_cfb_ridge$cvm)
out$ridge_lambda_min[i]=cv_cfb_ridge$lambda.min
}
```

```{r}
mean(out$lasso_cvm-out$ridge_cvm)
mean(out$lasso_cvm<out$ridge_cvm)
mean(out$lasso_lambda_min)
```

So lasso has a small cvm (cross validation measure) when s=lambda.min on average and that is true for 100%, all 20, of the cross validated randomiztions.

That suggest lasso is the way to go.

```{r}
fit_lasso<-glmnet(X,y,lambda=mean(out$lasso_lambda_min),alpha=1, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))
round(fit_lasso$beta,3)
print("Intercept")
round(coef(fit_lasso,s=mean(out$lasso_lambda_min))[1,1],3)
```

Get correlation between prediction and actual

```{r}

cor(predict(fit_lasso,newx=X),coach_all_df$sp_rel_team)
print(fit_lasso)
print(sqrt(mean(out$lasso_cvm))) 
```

Correlation is about $0.52$ and the percent of variability explained is about 25%.

Note that the mean cross-validated RMSE was $7.35$ and that suggests that our prediction is off on average by 7.4 points. There is a lot of variability in coaching hire outcomes.

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)   # Fast random forest package
library(xgboost)  # XGBoost package

numb_reps <- 20
nfolds <- 8

out <- data.frame(
  lasso_cvm        = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  lasso_lambda_min = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  ridge_cvm        = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  ridge_lambda_min = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  rf_cvm           = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  xgb_cvm          = rep(NA, numb_reps),
  xgb_nrounds_min  = rep(NA, numb_reps)
)

set.seed(110526)

for (i in 1:numb_reps) {
  # 0. Generate unified fold assignments for iteration i
  foldid <- sample(rep(1:nfolds, length.out = nrow(X)))
  xgb_folds <- split(seq_len(nrow(X)), foldid)  # Convert to list of test indices for XGBoost
  
  # 1. Lasso & Ridge (glmnet using foldid)
  cv_cfb_ridge <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, foldid = foldid, penalty.factor = c(0, rep(1, ncol(X) - 1)))
  cv_cfb_lasso <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, foldid = foldid, penalty.factor = c(0, rep(1, ncol(X) - 1)))
  
  out$lasso_cvm[i]        <- min(cv_cfb_lasso$cvm)
  out$lasso_lambda_min[i] <- cv_cfb_lasso$lambda.min
  out$ridge_cvm[i]        <- min(cv_cfb_ridge$cvm)
  out$ridge_lambda_min[i] <- cv_cfb_ridge$lambda.min
  
  # 2. Random Forest (ranger using foldid)
  rf_mse <- numeric(nfolds)
  for (k in 1:nfolds) {
    train_idx <- foldid != k
    test_idx  <- foldid == k
    
    rf_fit <- ranger(
      x = X[train_idx, ],
      y = y[train_idx],
      num.trees = 500
    )
    preds <- predict(rf_fit, data = X[test_idx, ])$predictions
    rf_mse[k] <- mean((y[test_idx] - preds)^2)
  }
  out$rf_cvm[i] <- mean(rf_mse)
  
  # 3. XGBoost (xgb.cv using xgb_folds)
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X), label = y)
  xgb_cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eval_metric = "rmse"),
    data = dtrain,
    folds = xgb_folds,
    nrounds = 100,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  out$xgb_cvm[i]         <- min(xgb_cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)^2
  out$xgb_nrounds_min[i] <- xgb_cv$early_stop$best_iteration
}
```

```{r}
out_mean_cv=data.frame(lasso=mean(out$lasso_cvm),
                       ridge=mean(out$ridge_cvm),
                       random_forests=mean(out$rf_cvm),
                       xgboost=mean(out$xgb_cvm))
out_mean_cv
```
```{r}
cv_cfb_lasso<-cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=1,nfolds=8, penalty.factor=c(0,rep(1,ncol(X)-1)))

coef(cv_cfb_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
plot(cv_cfb_lasso)
```
```{r}
coef_matrix <- coef(cv_cfb_lasso, s = "lambda.min")

# Option A: Extract as a named vector
coef_vec <- as.matrix(coef_matrix)[, 1]
nonzero_coefs <- coef_vec[coef_vec != 0]

# Print non-zero coefficients (includes intercept if non-zero)
print(round(nonzero_coefs,2))
```
```{r}
# 1. Minimum CV MSE from the cv.glmnet object
mse_cv <- min(cv_cfb_lasso$cvm)

# 2. Population variance of y (matching glmnet's MSE denominator)
var_y <- mean((y - mean(y))^2)

# 3. Cross-validated R-squared
r2_cv <- 1 - (mse_cv / var_y)
print(r2_cv)
```
```{r}
pred_lasso_min=predict(cv_cfb_lasso,X,type="response", s = "lambda.min")
truth_table=table(pred_lasso_min>0,coach_all_df$sp_rel_team>0)
accuracy_lasso=100*round(sum(diag(truth_table))/sum(truth_table),2)
```

```{r}
top_coaches=coach_all_df %>%
  arrange(desc(sp_rel_team)) %>%
  mutate(Rank=1:nrow(coach_all_df)) %>%
  select (Rank,name,school,sp_rel_team, sp_rel_team_z,numb_seasons) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  mutate(sp_rel_team=round(sp_rel_team,1)) %>%
  mutate(sp_rel_team_z=round(sp_rel_team_z,2)) 

bottom_coaches=coach_all_df %>%
  arrange(sp_rel_team) %>%
   mutate(Rank=nrow(coach_all_df):1) %>%
  select (Rank,name,school,sp_rel_team, sp_rel_team_z,numb_seasons) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  mutate(sp_rel_team=round(sp_rel_team,1)) %>%
  mutate(sp_rel_team_z=round(sp_rel_team_z,2)) %>%

top_bottom=bind_rows(top_coaches,bottom_coaches)


kable(top_bottom,col.names = c("Rank","Coach","School", "SP+ Rel", "SP+ Rel Z", "Seasons as Coach"),  caption = "Top 10 and Bottom 10 Coaching Performances")
```
